preprocessingOperations.name: NoData & Swath Edge Masking
preprocessingOperations.description: Zero, negative, and non-finite pixels outside the orbital swath were isolated and assigned standard GIS NoData (-9999.0).

preprocessingOperations.name: Radiometric Conversion to Decibels
preprocessingOperations.description: Linear power values converted to logarithmic radar backscatter scale using 10 * log10(intensity).

preprocessingOperations.name: Robust Dynamic Range Percentile Clipping
preprocessingOperations.description: Backscatter dynamic range clipped between 2nd percentile (-35.32 dB) and 98th percentile (-16.21 dB) to remove speckle outliers.

preprocessingOperations.name: Mild 3x3 Spatial Speckle Filtering
preprocessingOperations.description: Adaptive 3x3 median filter applied to suppress granular SAR speckle while preserving sharp radar gradients and boundaries.

preprocessingOperations.name: Linear Contrast Stretch to 8-bit Grayscale
preprocessingOperations.description: Mapped the clipped dB range linearly to [0, 255] for standard display.

scientificNotice: This preprocessing is radiometric calibration and visualization only. Dark features in SAR can be caused by low wind, biogenic films, or surface slicks. No automatic oil-spill detection or attribution is asserted.
